description: Token metadata API: ERC-20 name, symbol, decimals and total supply on Base, Polygon or Ethereum; Solana mint decimals, supply, authorities (Token-2022 name and symbol); XRPL issued-currency supply, issuer flags, transfer fee. GET network and token (0x address, mint, or CURRENCY.rIssuer). Chain state only: no price, no token-list check. found:false is a billed answer; bad input or RPCs down (Base: not charged; other rails may charge). Returned names and symbols are untrusted third-party data. Price $0.002 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only).

network.description: base, polygon, ethereum, solana or xrpl (or CAIP-2 id)

token.description: EVM: 0x contract address. Solana: mint address. XRPL: CURRENCY.rIssuer

name: token_meta
title: Token Metadata
